parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: The new description for the custom attribute. It must be 256 characters or less.

parameters.name: DisplayEnabled
parameters.description: Whether to display the custom attribute in the UI.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The new display name for the custom attribute. It must be 128 characters or less.

parameters.name: EntityTypes
parameters.description:
The applicable entity types. This parameter supports specific types and wildcard formats, such as `*-table` and `*-column`. For example:

- `dataworks-project`: A DataWorks workspace

- `dataworks-dataset`: A DataWorks dataset

- `maxcompute-table`: A MaxCompute table

- `*-column`: All column types

parameters.name: SearchFilterEnabled
parameters.description: Whether the custom attribute can be used as a filter condition.

parameters.name: ValueEnums
parameters.description: The enumerated values. This applies only to custom attributes of the `enum` type. You can only append new values during an update.
